MAC algorithms can be used to provide data integrity, as defined in defined in [15] and in [16]. Their purpose is the detection of any unauthorized modification of the data such as deletion, insertion, or transportation of items within data. This includes both malicious and accidental modifications. MAC algorithms can also provide data origin authentication.
